profile: An engineer who learned to love the funnel. Senior product manager and hands-on AI builder with 6+ years across backend engineering, product management and D2C growth: consumer subscriptions at Times Internet, international D2C at VAHDAM India, and now founder of Parwah. Combines discovery, experimentation and commercial judgement with the ability to design and ship working products.

roles.title: Parwah | Founder
roles.sub: Family-care platform for India, built end to end; alongside it, independent AI and consumer products.
bullets: Founded and built Parwah, a live family-care platform, owning discovery, UX and engineering, so relatives in different cities can coordinate care through shared tasks, documents and parent-controlled permissions.

Independent builds alongside Parwah: Lifecycle OS (16-module D2C campaign-planning platform), The Third Eye (AI assistant with retrieval memory, tool calling and voice) and Mailer Architect (multi-model, brand-aware HTML email workflow). All 24 builds are on page 2.

roles.title: VAHDAM India | AGM, Product Management & D2C Growth
roles.sub: D2C product strategy, conversion optimisation and lifecycle growth across US, UK and global markets.
bullets: Used funnel analysis to prioritise improvements to purchase journeys, conversion and lifecycle CRM.

Connected customer analytics, segmentation, campaign planning and email production into a retention workflow; ran Klaviyo and WebEngage experiments that contributed to UK marketing revenue growth within two months.

roles.title: Times Internet | Senior Product Manager
roles.sub: Consumer subscriptions, revenue and growth across ET Prime, ET Markets, Times Health+ and the Times Internet Half Marathon.
bullets: Scaled ET Prime Assisted Sales revenue from ₹15 lakh to ₹80 lakh per month in four months through funnel redesign and A/B experimentation; delivered 400%+ ROI within six months. Received the ET Prime Team Award (2025) as part of the team.
Led the ET Markets web and mobile-web redesign: +27% engagement and ₹3 crore+ incremental annual revenue. App improvements contributed to +25% DAU, +15% session duration and +19% screen views.

Launched the inaugural Times Internet Delhi Half Marathon 2026 from 0 to 1 at Dhyan Chand National Stadium, owning discovery, registration, acquisition funnels and on-ground runner insights; 18K+ runners and a new revenue stream.
Launched Times Health+ paid wellness subscriptions from scratch: freemium-to-paid journeys, pricing experiments and retention-led monetisation, creating a new paid tier and revenue line.
Built assisted-buying journeys that increased qualified leads from approximately 30 to 150+ per day; onboarding and engagement experiments improved subscriber retention by 10%.
Built AI TeleSuite for call transcription, quality scoring and pitch guidance to standardise Assisted Sales coaching.
roles.previous_roles: Promoted twice in under three years: APM (Jun 2022) → PM (Sep 2023) → Senior PM (Apr 2025)
